title: American Height Gained 6 Centimeters While Other Countries Passed
hook: American men gained 6 centimeters, but other countries grew faster.
closing: Height reflects living conditions, so national rankings can change within generations.
question: Are you taller than your grandparents?

segments.say: American men averaged 177 centimeters by 2014. A century of growth still was not enough to keep the lead.
South Korean women gained 20.2 centimeters. Other populations improved far faster than Americans.
By 2014, 36 countries had taller men. America's modest gains became a ranking collapse.
